items.title: EES-WMS-24-001, Blue Box Transition Details Update
TSD-TRS-24-005, Grand River Transit - Ridership Update - 2023 Year End
notes:
Responding to questions from the Committee, Doug Spooner, Director Transit Services, confirmed that the goal of 2.5% for MobilityPLUS undelivered trips is still the set target for 2024 and that Grand River Transit is now up to their full complement of pre-pandemic MobilityPLUS operators. D. Spooner also shared that staff will be returning to the Committee in April regarding MobilityPLUS software and its ability to manage bookings and trips. 

In response to a question from the Committee, D. Spooner confirmed that printed schedules are available at Grand River Transit Customer Service Centres. 

This report was received for information.

items.title: EES-WAS-24-003, 2023 Drinking Water Summary Report, Quality Management System Review and Infrastructure Maintenance Plan (Staff Presentation)
notes:
Jennifer Rose, Commissioner, Engineering and Environmental Services introduced the report, noting that this is a mandated report under the Safe Drinking Water Act. 

Mari MacNeil, Director, Water and Wastewater Services, provided a presentation, which included an overview of the Safe Drinking Water Act standard of care, 2024 external audit, and capacity to support housing. 

A copy of the presentation is attached to the minutes. 

Responding to questions from the Committee, J. Rose noted that staff are determining which projects may be eligible for the Housing-Enabling Water System fund, and that staff can share with Council which projects are being reviewed for eligibility. 

In response to a question from the Committee, M. MacNeil confirmed that outreach and education programs are being looked at, which includes programming focused on newcomers to the area to increase their understanding on the reliability and cleanliness of the Region's drinking water. M. MacNeil also noted that staff can work on arranging Water and Wastewater tours for Council.

items.title: EES-WAS-24-004, Servicing of Petersburg (Knipfel) Drinking Water System
notes:
J. Rose introduced the report, noting that the Township of Wilmot will be responsible for the water distribution and the Region will be responsible for the water treatment, and that the additional position will support the work within the Safe Drinking Water Act requirements. 

Responding to questions from the Committee, J. Rose confirmed that the funding for the position will be from water rates, and that it was not introduced during the 2024 budget, as the orders to be responsible for the water treatment were received in January, after budget confirmation.
